headline: Legal Secretary
summary: Legal secretary with three years supporting lawyers in a Digos law office. I prepare and compile legal documents, do basic legal research, manage the lawyers' calendars and hearing schedules, and keep files and correspondence organised.

experience.title: Legal Secretary
bullets: Type and format pleadings, affidavits and letters for three lawyers.
Compile annexes and prepare copies for filing and service.
Manage hearing schedules and remind lawyers of deadlines.
Look up laws and decisions requested by the lawyers.
Keep the correspondence log and case folders complete.

experience.title: Office Clerk
bullets: Filed documents, answered phones and prepared simple letters.
Maintained the office's incoming mail log.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Office Administration
